integrity: The Rota-Baxter equations are reconstructed from the defining identity, the automorphism group is derived from e1*e1=e2, and the conjugation action is explicit. A standalone exhaustive checker independently verifies the solution sets and orbit partitions over four finite prime fields.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats only the nontrivial two-dimensional square Zinbiel algebra.
The arbitrary-field classification is set-theoretic and does not determine the scheme structure of the Rota-Baxter solution variety.
A specialized or unindexed source may contain the same automorphism-orbit classification.
title: Rota–Baxter moduli of the two-dimensional square Zinbiel algebra
